Inspection-only socket that reads the Pear certificate for operator consent; no data is sent and it is destroyed on secureConnect.

Streamer.bot's WebSocket protocol mandates base64(sha256(password + salt)) then sha256 with the challenge; this is the challenge response, not password storage. See docs/security/codeql-suppressions.md.
